request.query: What is the default value, limit, requirement, or documented behavior of `https.ServerOptions`?
request.instructions: A passage answers only if it itself states a concrete value, limit, version, or rule for `https.ServerOptions`. A passage that only mentions the name, or only uses it in an example without stating a rule, does not answer.

documents.title: docs/config/preview-options.md > Preview Options > preview.https
documents.text:
## preview.https

- **Type:** `https.ServerOptions`
- **Default:** [`server.https`](./server-options#server-https)

Enable TLS + HTTP/2.

See [`server.https`](./server-options#server-https) for more details.

documents.title: docs/config/server-options.md > Server Options > server.https
documents.text:
## server.https

- **Type:** `https.ServerOptions`

Enable TLS + HTTP/2. The value is an [options object](https://nodejs.org/api/https.html#https_https_createserver_options_requestlistener) passed to `https.createServer()`.

A valid certificate is needed. For a basic setup, you can add [@vitejs/plugin-basic-ssl](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-basic-ssl) to the project plugins, which will automatically create and cache a self-signed certificate. But we recommend creating your own certificates.
